newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Preliminary investigation into last night's bomb blast in a Paris suburban train suggests Moslem extremists may be responsible for the attack which killed two people.
-- Government suspends sale of electronics and defence group Thomson SA because the privatisation commission does not approve the sale of part of the group to Korea's Daewoo .
-- Report by MATIF futures and options exchange calls for launch of a euro-interest rate future and explores difficulties in switching existing contracts into euro-denominated products.
-- Paribas subsidiary Compagnie Bancaire expects to post a 1.2-billion-franc loss for 1996.
